title: Feature Flag System
description: Build a feature flag system with boolean/percentage/targeted rollouts, gradual ramping, and user overrides.

steps.title: Create flag data structure
steps.description: Define a `Flag` data structure with: `key` (string), `type` (string: 'boolean', 'percentage', 'targeted', 'experiment'), `variants` (object mapping variant name to payload), `rules` (array of targeting rules), and `defaultVariant`. Create flags for 'dark-mode', 'new-checkout', 'premium-features', and 'recommendation-algo' and print each flag's configuration.
hints: Use type-specific fields stored in a rules or config sub-object
variants should map variant names to their payloads, e.g. { on: true, off: false }
Print flag config in a readable format with key, type, and available variants

verification.successMessage: Flag data structures with multiple types and variants are correctly defined and printed!
verification.failureMessage: Print each flag showing its key, type, variants, and default variant.

steps.title: Implement boolean flags
steps.description: Build a `FlagEvaluator` class with `isEnabled(key, context)` that evaluates boolean flags and returns true/false. Boolean flags have two variants: `on` (enabled) and `off` (disabled). The flag's rules determine which variant applies. Register 'dark-mode' as a boolean flag, evaluate it for three test users, and print enabled/disabled for each.
hints: For boolean flags, look up the active variant and convert to boolean: variant.payload === true
context should contain user info: { userId, country, plan, role }
Print 'dark-mode for user<id>: enabled' or 'dark-mode for user<id>: disabled'

verification.successMessage: Boolean flags correctly evaluate to enabled or disabled based on configuration!
verification.failureMessage: Print 'dark-mode for user<id>: enabled' or '...disabled' for each user evaluation.

steps.title: Add percentage rollout
steps.description: Implement gradual percentage-based rollouts. Add a `percentage` field to flag rules. Use a deterministic hash of the user ID to assign users to a bucket (0-99). If the bucket is below the rollout percentage, the variant is on; otherwise off. Create a 'new-checkout' flag at 30% rollout and evaluate it for 10 users, printing each user's bucket and assignment.
hints: Use a simple hash function: hash = userId.charCodeAt(0) or a proper hash modulo 100
The same user should always get the same bucket for consistent experience
Print 'user<id>: bucket=<N>, < 30, enabled' or 'bucket=<N>, >= 30, disabled'

verification.successMessage: Percentage rollout deterministically assigns users to buckets and respects the rollout percentage!
verification.failureMessage: Print each user's bucket and whether they are in or out of the rollout, e.g. 'userA: bucket=22, within 30% -> enabled'.

steps.title: Implement targeted flags
steps.description: Add user attribute targeting to flag rules. Support targeting by `country`, `plan` (free/pro/enterprise), and `role` (admin/user). Each rule specifies target attributes and a variant. Evaluate 'premium-features' with rules targeting enterprise plan users in the US. Print match results showing which rules matched for each test user.
hints: Each targeting rule has: { attributes: { country: 'US' }, variant: 'on' }
A rule matches when ALL specified attributes match the user context
First matching rule wins — print the matched rule and assigned variant

verification.successMessage: Targeted flags correctly match users based on country, plan, and role attributes!
verification.failureMessage: Print which targeting rule matched each user, e.g. 'userA: matched rule country=US,plan=enterprise -> variant=on'.

steps.title: Add A/B test variants
steps.description: Implement multi-variant experiment flags with weighted distribution. A 'recommendation-algo' experiment has three variants: `control` (30% weight), `algo-a` (50% weight), and `algo-b` (20% weight). Use the user ID hash to select a variant based on cumulative weights. Evaluate for 20 users and print the distribution count per variant.
hints: Assign each variant a weight, compute cumulative ranges: control=0-29, algo-a=30-79, algo-b=80-99
Use the same bucket hash from percentage rollout and map into the cumulative ranges
Print 'Variant distribution: control=N, algo-a=N, algo-b=N' after evaluating all users

verification.successMessage: A/B test variants are assigned according to their weighted distribution across users!
verification.failureMessage: Print 'User<id> assigned to variant <variant>' for each user, then show total distribution.

steps.title: Implement user overrides
steps.description: Add a user override system that takes priority over all other evaluation rules. Support two override types: `forceOn` (always enabled for a user) and `forceOff` (always disabled). Each override specifies a `userId` and a `variant`. Store overrides in a map and check them before evaluating any rules. Print the active overrides list and demonstrate a forced override.
hints: Check overrides as the first step in evaluate() — if userId has an override, return that variant immediately
Overrides map: { 'user-admin': { variant: 'on' }, 'user-test': { variant: 'off' } }
Print 'Override active for <userId>: forcing variant <variant> — skipping rule evaluation'

verification.successMessage: User overrides correctly bypass normal flag evaluation and force the assigned variant!
verification.failureMessage: Print active overrides and show that overriding a user bypasses all rules.

steps.title: Build evaluation pipeline
steps.description: Combine everything into a complete evaluation pipeline: `evaluate(flagKey, context)` that runs targeting rules -> percentage rollout -> user overrides -> default variant. Implement `getFullEvalResult(flagKey, context)` that returns the matched rule, variant, payload, and evaluation reason. Test with multiple flags and contexts, printing the full pipeline trace for each.
hints: Chain the checks in priority order: overrides first, then targeting rules, then percentage, then default
getFullEvalResult() should return { flag, variant, payload, reason: 'override' | 'targeted' | 'rollout' | 'default' }
Print the full evaluation trace showing each step checked and the final result

verification.successMessage: Evaluation pipeline correctly chains all checks in priority order and provides full trace!
verification.failureMessage: Print the full evaluation result showing flag, variant, payload, and reason for each test case.
